subject.title: [Feature]: Mattermost thread-participation auto-follow has no `thread.requireExplicitMention` opt-out (Slack has it)

question: Should Mattermost adopt the Slack-parity `thread.requireExplicitMention` opt-in as its supported way to prevent bot participation from bypassing mention gating?
rationale: The implementation is narrow, but repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration surfaces and the permanent Mattermost thread-participation policy belongs to the channel owner.

options.title: Sponsor Slack parity
options.body: Add the opt-in at channel and per-account scope with a default that preserves existing participation behavior.

options.title: Design disengagement first
options.body: Defer this key and instead define a broader per-thread leave or participation-control model shared across relevant channels.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Slack parity
recommendation.body: Add the opt-in at channel and per-account scope with a default that preserves existing participation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the repository-routed Mattermost owner and has recent history on Mattermost thread behavior.
